title: In ankhon ne dekha
body:
marqad pe bayan karti thi ye zainab e dukhiya
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane ke liye aayi hoon kya kya
in aankhon ne dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir liye aaye abaa mein jo utha kar
tha dard ka manzar
pamaal shuda qasim e naushah ka laasha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki sada sun ke jo maidan gaye thay
bhaiya thay akele
bete ke jawan laash ko laate huwe tanha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha seena e aqdas pa chada shimre sitamgar
tha haath mein khanjar
khanjar ke talay aap ke bete ka gala tha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam hui ban mein to phir zulm naya tha
phat'ta tha kaleja
hote huwe pamaal mere bhai ka laasha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e gariban mein jalaye gaye qaime
har simt thay shole
sholon ki lapeton mein wo jalta hua jhoola
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo zulm o sitam shaam talak karbobala se
bacchi pa huwe thay
ruksaar sakina pa wo har ek tamacha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazron se sakina ki nigahon ko bachaye
darya ke kanare
haathon ko kataye mera abbas pada tha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum log rasan basta phiraye gaye dar dar
be-makhna o chadar
bazaron mein bante huwe khud apna tamasha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad pa jameel ek qayamat ka samaan tha
zainab ka tha nauha
amma ye kaho aur sunaun tumhe kya kya
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
author: Jameel Moosavi
